hook: In November 2026, 35 percent of safety recalls were classified as Severe.

sections.voiceover: In November 2026, 35 percent of safety recalls were classified as Severe.
b_roll: motion graphics displaying 35 percent severe hazard classification graphic

sections.voiceover: The Recall Desk logged 247 recalls across agencies that month. FDA Drugs led the breakdown with 90 recalls, while FDA Devices had 85. Which agency accounted for 31 recall events?
b_roll: bar chart showing FDA Drugs at 90 and FDA Devices at 85 recalls

sections.voiceover: However, NHTSA posted 31 recall events, while both CPSC and FDA didn't top 19 each.
b_roll: agency comparison chart listing NHTSA at 31, CPSC at 19, and FDA at 19

sections.voiceover: Recall Atlas recorded 200 global safety alerts in one week during November 2026. The United States generated 63 of those safety alerts. Meanwhile, USDA FSIS recorded 2 recall events.
b_roll: map graphic highlighting 63 US alerts out of 200 global safety alerts

sections.voiceover: That leaves 1 percent of November recalls marked as Critical.
b_roll: pie chart highlighting 1 percent critical hazard classification
